resolution: The final heads of176 and196 are not ancestors of197, although their reviewed file-safety and drill changes were also applied to197. Preserve their original histories as additional normal parents without reverting the reviewed197 extension or current main. The current assembled runtime is authoritative; older password-reentry behavior is replaced with current owner-session checks and all explicit confirmation/CSRF/private-storage boundaries retained. New prune, ZIP-close, retention and file-mode fixes remain in the corrected candidate.
preservation: All160 predecessor native commands and the exact historical browser inverse remain. The backup fixture is expanded, not skipped. Obsolete workflow/docs conflicts use current main guidance; the historical deltas remain in BACKUPS_HISTORY_INTEGRATION.json and original ancestors.
sensitive_scope: A file manifest excludes private config/key/storage paths. The separate SQL export DOES contain sensitive business/account data and potentially encrypted credentials; the archive is private and original encryption keys must be retained separately. File restore never imports the SQL export.
status: Source consolidation only. Exact-source native/browser/build success is required before main merge. No deployment, payment, provider operation or delivered ZIP replacement.
